title: B · JD → traceable requirements
summary: Save exact text and hash → Python passage IDs and offsets → account for every nonblank source span.
body:
Save exact text and hash → Python passage IDs and offsets → account for every nonblank source span.

In parallel: Jev passage classification and one structured extraction request.

Classification: work, qualification, technology, company context, mixed or uncertain.

Python verifies quotes/IDs; Jev checks the interpretation against original passages.

Each requirement: source passage, interpretation, priority, meaningful child components, named technologies, unresolved interpretation.

Invalid/missing interpretation → retain original passage and mark unresolved; do not repeatedly regenerate extraction.

Compound requirements remain unresolved until their meaningful components are accounted for.
